changes: ce_approx changed from 1682 to 1681: the Nepāla saṃvat year begins in Kārttika, so Kārttika śukla 14 of NS 802 falls in about October–November 1681 CE
Added a note on the era reckoning and on the corrupt spelling saṃpūrṇṇa (!) riṣita (!)

notes: The era is not named ('saṃvat 802'). The Newari wording (kunhu, the instrumental -na) and the karmācārya scribe point to Nepāla saṃvat, which matches the catalogue. NS 802 + 880 gives 1682. However, the NS year begins with Kārttika śukla, so Kārttika śukla 14 of NS 802 falls in about October–November 1681 CE. 'riṣita (!)' is a corrupt spelling of likhita, and the Newari instrumental -na on nārāyaṇasiṃhana marks him as the scribe. 'saṃpūrṇṇa (!)' stands for saṃpūrṇa. The colophon names no weekday or place.
